note: The living registry of every status, condition, mechanic, enchantment, affix and field effect (Ricardo 2026-07-10). Source of truth for the in-game CODEX (synced to game/prototype/data/effects.json). Extend by ADDING entries — weekly content never requires engine work (canon).

entries.name: Physical
entries.desc: mitigated by armor: reduction = armor/(armor+150)

entries.name: Fire
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; fuels Ignite and fire fields

entries.name: Frost
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; frost bolts apply Chill

entries.name: Storm
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; shock/chain themes

entries.name: Venom
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; stacking DoT themes

entries.name: Umbral
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; the Gloom's own element (Shadow Rend, wisp bolts)

entries.name: Blood
entries.desc: resist-mitigated; leech/sacrifice themes (blood_price keystone leeches)

entries.name: Ignite
entries.desc: fire DoT, 0.5 s ticks; refreshed on re-application (Rune of Cinders: 3/s for 3 s)

entries.name: Chill
entries.desc: -35% move speed for 1.2 s (frost wisp bolts); icy tint on the hero

entries.name: Bleed
entries.desc: stacking physical DoT (max 5 stacks, ~8% melee dmg/stack/s, 4 s, 0.5 s ticks); refreshed on re-application — Reaver/Veilblade skill trees

entries.name: Expose
entries.desc: +20% damage taken from ALL sources for 4 s (Sunder Armor, Unravel, Mark the Vein); pallid tint

entries.name: Stagger
entries.desc: 0.5 s stun — the creature's state machine freezes; DoTs keep ticking (Bull Rush, Winter's Grip)

entries.name: Enrage
entries.desc: +30% move speed 5 s on a resisted Soul Snare; red tint

entries.name: Knockback
entries.desc: impulse displacement on the hero (boss Wing Gust)

entries.name: Shove
entries.desc: instant displacement on creatures (Rune of the Gale burst)

entries.name: Hitstop
entries.desc: 45 ms global 0.15x time-scale punch on melee connect

entries.name: Dodge displacement
entries.desc: 4 m dash, 3 charges, 1.5 s refill each, NO i-frames — position is the defense

entries.name: Pet Rest
entries.desc: pets at 0 HP rest 15 s then return — they never die; they respawn with the hunter

entries.name: Death penalty
entries.desc: lose 25% of carried gold on death (full owner rules: design/12)

groups.name: Rune effects (canon §4 — one socket per skill)

entries.name: Rune of Echoes
entries.desc: the skill repeats at 40% damage 0.25 s later

entries.name: Rune of Cinders
entries.desc: hits Ignite (3/s scaled by Intellect, 3 s) and scorch the ground

entries.name: Rune of the Gale
entries.desc: dodging leaves a wind burst: 10 damage + shove within 1.5 m

entries.name: Umbral Edge
entries.desc: Abyssal Remnant on weapon/amulet: +4-10% umbral damage (rolled); REPLACES the previous enchant

entries.name: Safe enchanting
entries.desc: enchanting NEVER destroys gear (Ricardo 2026-07-10) — the essence is the only cost

entries.name: Brutal
entries.desc: +50% damage; red-tinted

entries.name: Swift
entries.desc: +40% move speed, -25% attack cooldown; cyan-tinted

entries.name: Fiery
entries.desc: strikes add a +50% fire packet; ember-tinted

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.desc: +80% max HP; gold-tinted

entries.name: Gloamfen Stalker
entries.desc: baseline pack melee; capturable (Abyssal family)

entries.name: Lunger
entries.desc: fast and frail: +45% speed, -35% HP; POUNCES 3 m onto you from mid-range (sidestep the flash)

entries.name: Brute
entries.desc: slow wall: +90% HP, +70% damage, double gold; radial ground SLAM with a telegraph circle — dodge OUT

entries.name: Gloamfen Wisp (umbral)
entries.desc: kiting caster, violet bolts

entries.name: Ember Wisp
entries.desc: hotter bolts (fire, 12 damage)

entries.name: Frost Wisp
entries.desc: weaker bolts (8) that Chill the hero

entries.name: Emberwing Matriarch
entries.desc: 5-skill Elite boss: Ember Bolt, Talon Dive, Wing Gust, Ember Screech (60%), Magma Breath fields (30%)

entries.name: Fenwitch Hag
entries.desc: Elite mid-boss (pack 8): Hex Bolt volley, Blink, Wispling Call (summons), Creeping Mire slow fields, Shrieking Curse enrage below 40%

entries.name: Pyre Sovereign + Terravore Colossus
entries.desc: LEGENDARY duo (pack 11): Meteor Call, Cinder Breath, gusts + Earthshatter, Stone Spikes, earth fields; the survivor enrages when its partner falls; epic+ loot each

entries.name: Bestiary — normals
entries.desc: 1000 data-defined creatures (bestiary_normal.json): family bundle x element x tint x scale x stat rolls; pure data, weekly-extensible

entries.name: Bestiary — legendaries
entries.desc: 100 named legendaries (bestiary_legendary.json) over dragon/colossus/hag chassis with elemental kits and lore

entries.name: Species roster
entries.desc: each hunt samples 6-10 species from the 1000; packs read as one species with a 25% stray chance per member

entries.name: Hunt legendary
entries.desc: one sampled legendary per hunt (pack 13): chassis by base, NORMALIZED HP budget (x1.4-3.0 of the 900 reference — flow over sponge, threat comes from dmg x1.3-2.2), guaranteed rare+ drop (60/30/10 rare/epic/legendary) rolled at quality 0.5, 10% Soul Snare shower; magenta diamond on the minimap

entries.name: Hitbox scaling
entries.desc: collision radius follows the sprite: bestiary scale multiplies body_radius; lungers 8.0 / brutes 11.5 base

entries.name: Power scaling — normals
entries.desc: read at spawn from hunter level: HP +2%/level, damage +1%/level, gold rides the damage curve

entries.name: Power scaling — bosses
entries.desc: all bosses incl. hunt legendaries: HP +6%/level, damage +3%/level (also scales every scripted boss skill packet)

entries.name: Wisp element mapping
entries.desc: bestiary element -> bolt flavor: fire->ember, frost->frost, others->umbral (until 7-type bolts land)

entries.name: Orbital Ribbon Trails
entries.desc: Pooled MultiMesh2D swept-quad ribbons (40x16=640 inst, 1 draw call, shared ADD material). Orbit/crescent/streak/radial modes drive whirlwind vortices, cleaves, dash streaks, projectile trails, death finales.

entries.name: Screen Post-FX
entries.desc: One full-frame canvas shader (chromatic aberration + vignette + over-bright) on a dedicated CanvasLayer(5). pulse() kicks aberration on signature hits; skipped below intensity 0.15. gl_compatibility fake-bloom; Vulkan adds HDR glow on top via set_hdr_mode.

entries.name: Converging Beam Telegraph
entries.desc: Red tapered wedges converging inward before a boss impact (dive, screech, meteor, spikes, enrage). Pooled telegraph descriptor, never intensity-scaled.

entries.name: Ground Danger Ring
entries.desc: Pooled amber filling ring under every dangerous windup (24-descriptor telegraph layer, 2 draw calls). Replaces per-cast telegraph nodes.

entries.name: Protective / Enrage Aura
entries.desc: Persistent glowing ring + orbiting ribbons following an owner. Green = player buff protection; red/orange = boss enrage.

entries.name: Punchy Damage Numbers
entries.desc: Pooled 48-label ring, scale-pop + crit grammar + vertical stacking, one shared _process, zero per-hit allocation.

entries.name: Shockwave
entries.desc: Fat multi-ring additive nova for impacts, novas, and deaths (RING_POOL 12).

entries.name: Intensity knob
entries.desc: Single ProtoFx.intensity in [0,1] (LOW/MED/HIGH = 0.15/0.5/1.0, mobile default MED) gates per-frame usage only, never allocation; telegraphs exempt (gameplay clarity).

entries.name: Procedural shader FX (vfx_lab)
entries.desc: Five pure-math canvas_item fragment effects — slash, nova, vortex, firestorm, impact (SDF + fBm + chromatic dispersion) — authored as numpy previews (genforge/vfx_lab) and ported 1:1. Pooled 12-quad system (shader_fx.gd), ALL materials pre-compiled at load; canvas_items stretch renders them at WINDOW resolution: smooth hi-res effects over the pixel world.

entries.name: Elite rim glow
entries.desc: Colored silhouette outline (rim_glow.gdshader, 8-tap alpha edge) on elites (affix color), boss chassis (bar color) and hunt legendaries (magenta) — the Phantom Tower / Hades elite read; materials shared per color.

entries.name: Fire field
entries.desc: burning ground, DoT ticks every 0.25 s; glows and telegraphs on landing

entries.name: Earth field
entries.desc: Terravore rubble ground — the fuel half of the lava combo

entries.name: Creeping Mire
entries.desc: Fenwitch slow-field: heavy Chill re-applied every tick while inside

entries.name: Scorch
entries.desc: brief ground decal from Cinders hits (visual)

entries.name: Lava (Duologue)
entries.desc: while BOTH duo bosses live, fire over earth fuses into LAVA — 14 dps, 10 s, the hottest glow in the game (registries/fields.json made playable)

groups.name: Skill trees (five classes — skill_trees.json, 1 point per level)

entries.name: Tree scope
entries.desc: every class: 20 actives + 8 passives (1 keystone w/ tradeoff) + free root = 29 nodes, 145 total; ONE generic executor runs all actives from data — weekly skills never require engine work

entries.name: Active kinds
entries.desc: projectile / nova / cone / melee_arc / dash_strike / buff / field / chain — param-driven (count, radius, element, duration, mults)

entries.name: Skill bar 1-4
entries.desc: keys 1-4 cast learned class-tree actives assigned in CHARACTER -> Skills; loadout persists per character; cooldowns per node, scaled by cooldown_reduction passives

entries.name: Status payoff
entries.desc: skills declare bonus_vs {status: mult} — e.g. Shatter deals x2 to Chilled prey; consumes [status] spends the mark on hit

entries.name: Ignite spread
entries.desc: Emberwake: a struck creature's burn leaps to packmates within 2.5 m

entries.name: Ignite detonation
entries.desc: Cinderburst / Heart of the Pyre: consumes the target's remaining burn and pops it as instant fire AoE (x1.2-1.5)

entries.name: Attunement (Gloam Mage)
entries.desc: arcane builders +1 stack (max 5); release skills spend all stacks for +25% damage each

entries.name: Combo (Veilblade)
entries.desc: stab-tagged builders +1 stack (max 5); spender skills release all stacks for +25% damage each

entries.name: Friendly field
entries.desc: player-cast ground effects (Earthsplitter, Scorched Earth, Mirefen Call) tick CREATURES, never the hunter, and never fuse into Duologue lava

entries.name: Cleave (root)
entries.desc: the Reaver class active; learned from the start

entries.name: Whirlwind (E)
entries.desc: Reaver signature: full-circle strike at 0.8x melee + shove, 4 s cooldown

entries.name: Blood Price (keystone)
entries.desc: +10% blood leech on melee, -15 armor — a real tradeoff

groups.name: Classes (class-lite pass; full kits in design/10)

entries.name: Reaver
entries.desc: the balanced blade — umbral Shadow Rend, no tradeoffs

entries.name: Emberkin
entries.desc: +12% fire on every hit and 20% Ignite chance — but -10% max HP

entries.name: Frostbinder
entries.desc: +15% max HP and every hit Chills — but -8% damage

entries.name: Gloam Mage
entries.desc: ranged Arcane Bolts (LMB) + Frost Nova (E: radial chill), +15% skill damage — but -20% HP

entries.name: Veilblade (rogue)
entries.desc: Swift Stab (LMB: 60-degree 0.25 s cadence) + Fan of Knives (E: 5 steel fans), +10% crit and move — but -15% HP

entries.name: Arcane Bolt
entries.desc: friendly umbral projectile, 0.9x melee stat, 13 m/s

entries.name: Frost Nova
entries.desc: 2.8 m radial burst, 0.7x skill-scaled + 1.5 s hard Chill

entries.name: Fan of Knives
entries.desc: five 0.5x piercing knives in a 56-degree fan

entries.name: Six launch classes
entries.desc: full distinct kits, trees and resources (docs/design/10)

entries.name: Localization
entries.desc: chrome and content text carry _pt twins; ProtoLang picks by user language (user://settings.json, toggle in the main menu + Haven); skill trees fully bilingual (409 PT fields)

entries.name: Registry PT twins
entries.desc: give every registry group/entry name_pt/desc_pt so the CODEX follows the language — data-only, zero engine work

entries.name: Gloam Strider
entries.desc: walking mount, x1.6 speed; sold by the Haven vendor (400 g)

entries.name: Emberwing Drakeling
entries.desc: FLYING mount, x1.9 speed, crosses water/rock; bonds when the Matriarch falls

entries.name: Saddle rules
entries.desc: M mounts/dismounts; no combat from the saddle; damage knocks you off; flyers must land on solid ground

entries.name: Soul Snare capture
entries.desc: F on a <35% HP stalker within 3 m; chance 0.25 + 0.6 x missing-HP

entries.name: Instance roll
entries.desc: 2-3 skills from the family pool (~70:30 signature:shared) + 70-110% attribute roll

entries.name: Stables
entries.desc: overflow captures stable the OLDEST bond — pets are never abandoned; swap in CHARACTER → Pets

entries.name: Pet marketplace
entries.desc: pets fully tradable; perfect rolls are chase assets (web-only marketplace)

entries.name: Forge upgrade
entries.desc: +10% to all affix values per tier, max +5; cost 50 x 2^tier gold

entries.name: Forge fail risk
entries.desc: attempts into +4/+5 fail 25%/40% — gold burns, the item survives

entries.name: Loot level scaling
entries.desc: items roll at the hunter's level (ilvl): every stat roll grows 4%/level (~x5 at 100); boss drops quality-floored to the upper roll band

entries.name: Vendor sell
entries.desc: price scales with rarity and tier (gold sink); per-rarity sell-all chips clear junk in one click

entries.name: Haven chest
entries.desc: 120-slot stash at the Haven; bag <-> chest moves are free, stacks travel whole

entries.name: Item stacking
entries.desc: materials (Spirit Essences) stack into one slot with a qty badge; consuming/selling is stack-aware

entries.name: Player marketplace
entries.desc: real-money player-to-player trade via Pix — WEB-ONLY, never in mobile apps (hard rule)
